## Quality

Protein quality also must be taken into consideration with respect to the accretion of skeletal muscle mass. The quality of a protein is primarily a function of its composition of EAAs, in terms of both quantity and proportion. A complete protein contains a full complement of all nine EAAs in the approximate amounts needed to support lean tissue maintenance. Alternatively, proteins low in one or more of the EAAs are considered incomplete proteins . With the exception of gelatin, all animal-based proteins are complete proteins. Vegetable-based proteins, on the other hand, lack sufficient amounts of various EAAs, which makes them incomplete.
